Spanish 'altura / lo alto...

James urges the humble brother to 'boast in his exaltation' (Jas 1:9), where the word denotes dignity and divine honor rather than physical elevation. Spanish 'exaltación' and Hindi 'unche pad' (high position) mark the shift from spatial to social or spiritual height.
